name: idle
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Input image 1 is the approved Tafo FERRET identity reference. Generate a production 8-FRAME SPRITE SHEET, not a character concept sheet and not one still pose repeated. The entire output is a precise regular 4-COLUMN by 2-ROW grid: eight equal square cells, row-major reading order, on a wide 2:1 canvas. No gutters, no borders, no labels, no text. All background genuinely transparent alpha. Each cell contains ONE full ferret with generous transparent margins. Identical character scale, centered registration, fixed foot baseline and consistent camera in every cell; all fur and tail remain inside its own cell. Preserve the approved ferret AS IS: cream fur, cinnamon back stripe, dark brown paws and tail tip, dark eye mask, rounded ears, tiny expressive face, hand-painted paper-grain texture within the character only. No background texture, no shadows, no accessories. Every frame must be separately drawn with the specified changes to facial features, tail, limbs or body articulation; do not simulate animation by just translating or scaling a single image. Make actual readable frame-to-frame animation. Animation: a seamless subtle IDLE blink and tail-tip swish, curled sitting pose looking up and right like the reference's lower-left ferret. Frame 1: relaxed eyes open, tail resting. Frame 2: eyelids halfway down, ears relax slightly. Frame 3: eyes fully closed in a soft blink, tail tip lifts. Frame 4: eyes reopen, lifted tail tip curls inward. Frame 5: eyes open, tail tip swishes a little to the opposite side. Frame 6: head tilts upward slightly, ears perk, tail curls back. Frame 7: head and tail ease back toward rest. Frame 8: relaxed open-eyed original sitting pose, connects smoothly back to frame 1. The body and feet stay registered, the face and tail visibly change across the eight frames.
